mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dodo_show_activity (store_id, sort_order, start_time, end_time, ended, version, payload, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{sortOrder}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{ended}, #{version}, #{payload}, #{createMillis}, #{updateMillis})
mapper.update: UPDATE dodo_show_activity SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, ended = #{ended}, version = #{version}, payload = #{payload}, update_time = #{updateMillis} WHERE id = #{id} AND store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, store_id, sort_order, start_time, end_time, ended, version, payload, create_time, update_time FROM dodo_show_activity WHERE id = #{id} AND store_id = #{storeId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS submitted_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.audit_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.audit_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.reward_price), 0) AS issued_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS used_count FROM dodo_show_submission s LEFT JOIN dodo_coupon c ON c.id = s.coupon_id WHERE s.activity_id = #{activityId} AND s.store_id = #{storeId}
